label.en: Only show the time (the answer is given elsewhere in the item)
label.nl: Alleen de tijd tonen (antwoord elders in het item)

hint.en: A clock that only shows the time takes no answer and is not scored: add an interaction for the answer to the item, such as a text entry.
hint.nl: Een klok die alleen de tijd toont, neemt geen antwoord aan en wordt niet gescoord: voeg voor het antwoord een interactie aan het item toe, zoals een tekstinvoer.

typeOfQuestion.$comment: askTime: the clock stands in for an image, no response (config.tspci.toolWhen); setClock: the student sets the clock, which is the response

typeOfClock.$comment: Set in the authoring mode (authoring.tsx), with the skin: "analog" or "digital"

skin.$comment: Set in the authoring mode (authoring.tsx): analog "classic", "learning" or "roman"; digital "classic", "alarm" or "lcd". Unknown: "classic"

color.$comment: Set in the authoring mode: the colour of the rim (analog) or the case (digital), as "#rrggbb". Empty or unknown: the skin's own colour

hands.$comment: Set in the authoring mode: "ornate", "straight", "pointed" or "arrow". Empty or unknown: the skin's own hands

label.en: Colour of the short hand (analog only)
label.nl: Kleur van de kleine wijzer (alleen analoog)

shortHandColor.$comment: Set in the authoring mode: the colour of the short hand, as "#rrggbb". Empty or unknown: the skin's own colour

label.en: Colour of the long hand (analog only)
label.nl: Kleur van de grote wijzer (alleen analoog)

longHandColor.$comment: Set in the authoring mode: the colour of the long hand, as "#rrggbb". Empty or unknown: the skin's own colour

font.$comment: Set in the authoring mode: "sans", "serif" or "mono", for the numerals (analog) or the digits (digital). Empty or unknown: the skin's own font

twentyFourHour.$comment: true: the hours run from 00 to 23; false: from 1 to 12 (13:05 shows as 01:05). The analog clock always has 12 hours.
